items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: We had Roy Eldridge and Buck Clayton, if I didn't mention Buck before.

ctx.x: Hold it a minute. Let me see now. Well, when it says toured Europe with Jazz from the Swinging Era.

That still didn't take me away from George Wein. I had done work just before that and went back. You see, all those people in the group called Jazz of the Swing Era, were in the Newport Jazz Festival too. Because we had Earl Hines and Charles Thompson, the two pianists. We had Oliver Jackson, drums. All of these people played in the festival. We had Bill Pemberton, a marvelous bass player. We had Vic Dickenson. We had Roy Eldridge and Buck Clayton, if I didn't mention Buck before. We had Budd Johnson, Earl…
And so that band used to play together as a band.
